title: M2: Every note, faithfully: kits, overlapping notes, reverse, re-pitch and out-of-range levels
description:
## Purpose

Every note the engine plays is in the set, faithfully, including the cases a plain one-clip-per-note track can't hold: kits and step patterns, notes that sound at the same time on one track, reversed notes, re-pitched clips and speed flips, and levels outside the DAW's ranges.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  T["track 'stab' (voicing triad)"] --> G["group track 'stab'"]
  G --> L1["audio track 'stab 1'"]
  G --> L2["audio track 'stab 2'"]
  G --> L3["audio track 'stab 3'"]
```

A DAW audio track plays one clip at a time; notes of one track that overlap are spread over the fewest audio tracks that hold them, inside a group track that stands where the track would (proposal; confirmed in M0).

## Out of scope

Kits as drum rack instruments with MIDI (initiative apricitus-5562e0); here a kit track is audio clips, one per hit.

## Definition of Done

1. Specs: `features/daw/notes.feature`, steps in `features/daw/STEPS.md`; all green.
2. Rust in `apricity-daw` (+ decoding for reversed audio via `apricity-engine`'s `decode` feature if M0 chose pre-rendered reverse). Python parity: not applicable.
3. Schema: not applicable.
4. CLI: no new flags; new warnings carry track name and bar:beat.
5. Fixtures: generated in tests; no audio in git.
6. Design: `design/daw-set.md` sections on overlapping notes, reverse, re-pitch, range overflow.
7. Docs: `docs/concepts.md` DAW section updated; glossary if a word is added.
8. Web: none.
9. Verification: `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw`; manual DAW A/B of `examples/chop-shop.apr`, `examples/salamander-beat.apr`, `examples/minor-line.apr`, `examples/voice-layer.apr`.
10. Running log on each task. 11. `feat(<task id>)` per task; not breaking.
12. Depends on M1. M3's sidechain and M4's automation build on the lane groups made here.
